fact: New facts use .fact/records.tsv by default. Existing path#row-id references and explicit taskbook paths remain valid.
Use registered labels for recurring searches across fact records. Leave labels empty when an ID or the wording suffices.
Use the terms label to find definitions. An authored creation can request that label.
Use release tags and Git history to trace changes in fact wording.
source: Maintainer decision: retrieving earlier project facts from Git
